scripts.dev: npm run clean --silent && npm run mkdirs --silent && node scripts/update-dist.js && npm run start-dev --silent
scripts.watch: nodemon --quiet --watch src/site-content.json --watch src/index.html --watch src/styles --watch src/assets --delay 500ms --exec "node scripts/update-dist.js"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run mkdirs && npm run build:css && npm run build:html && npm run copy:build && npm run rewrite-css-paths && npm run inject-content
scripts.build:css: timestamp=$(date +%Y%m%d) && cleancss -o dist/styles/reset.min.$timestamp.css src/styles/reset.css && cleancss -o dist/styles/styles.min.$timestamp.css src/styles/styles.css
scripts.build:html: html-minifier --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --remove-optional-tags --remove-redundant-attributes --remove-script-type-attributes --remove-tag-whitespace --use-short-doctype --minify-css true --minify-js true --input-dir src/ --output-dir dist --file-ext html
scripts.copy:dev: shx cp src/assets/images/favicon.ico dist/assets/images && shx cp src/styles/reset.css dist/styles && shx cp src/styles/styles.css dist/styles && shx cp -r src/assets/images dist/assets && shx cp -r src/assets/fonts dist/assets && shx cp src/index.html dist/
scripts.copy:build: shx cp src/assets/images/favicon.ico dist/assets/images && shx cp -r src/assets/images dist/assets && shx cp -r src/assets/fonts dist/assets && shx cp src/index.html dist/
